001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.awt.BorderLayout;
004import java.awt.CardLayout;
005import java.awt.Color;
006import java.awt.Dimension;
007import java.awt.event.WindowAdapter;
008import java.awt.event.WindowEvent;
009
010import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
011import javax.swing.JFrame;
012import javax.swing.JLabel;
013import javax.swing.JMenu;
014import javax.swing.JMenuBar;
015import javax.swing.JMenuItem;
016import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
017import javax.swing.JPanel;
018import javax.swing.border.Border;
019
020/**
021 * Main application window for the DayPlanner Swing GUI.
022 * Uses a {@link CardLayout} to switch between views (welcome, add, search)
023 * within a single main {@link JFrame}, navigated via a {@link JMenuBar}.
024 */
025public class GUIDayPlanner extends JFrame {
026    /**
027     * Default dimensions of the main GUI window.
028     */
029    private static final Dimension DIMS = new Dimension(800, 600);
030
031    /**
032     * Title of the main GUI window.
033     */
034    private static final String TITLE = "DayPlanner";
035
036    /**
037     * Window close operation: do nothing on default close so custom quit flow is used.
038     */
039    private static final int CLOSE = JFrame.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE;
040
041    /**
042     * Background color for the window.
043     */
044    private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(220, 220, 220);
045
046    /**
047     * Padding border applied around components.
048     */
049    private static final Border PADDING = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12);
050
051    /**
052     * Reference to the activity list.
053     */
054    private ActivityList activities;
055
056    /**
057     * CardLayout managing in-place panel switching.
058     */
059    private CardLayout cardLayout;
060
061    /**
062     * Panel container holding the cards for CardLayout.
063     */
064    private JPanel cardsPanel;
065
066    /**
067     * Welcome text label on the initial welcome card.
068     */
069    private JLabel welcomeText;
070
071    /**
072     * Add activity view panel.
073     */
074    private GUIAddWindow addWindow;
075
076    /**
077     * Search activity view panel.
078     */
079    private GUISearchWindow searchWindow;
080
081    /**
082     * Main menu bar.
083     */
084    private JMenuBar menuBar;
085
086    /**
087     * Commands menu.
088     */
089    private JMenu commandsMenu;
090
091    /**
092     * Add command menu item.
093     */
094    private JMenuItem addMenuItem;
095
096    /**
097     * Search command menu item.
098     */
099    private JMenuItem searchMenuItem;
100
101    /**
102     * Quit command menu item.
103     */
104    private JMenuItem quitMenuItem;
105
106    /**
107     * Create a new DayPlanner Swing GUI window.
108     * 
109     * @param activities Defined ActivityList.
110     */
111    public GUIDayPlanner(ActivityList activities) {
112        // ==============================
113        // Window Setup
114        // ==============================
115
116        super();
117        this.activities = activities;
118
119        setSize(DIMS);
120        setTitle(TITLE);
121        setDefaultCloseOperation(CLOSE);
122        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
123        addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
124            @Override
125            public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
126                showGuiQuitMenu();
127            }
128        });
129
130        // ==============================
131        // Menu Bar
132        // ==============================
133
134        menuBar = new JMenuBar();
135        commandsMenu = new JMenu("Commands");
136
137        addMenuItem = new JMenuItem("Add");
138        addMenuItem.addActionListener(e -> showAdd());
139        commandsMenu.add(addMenuItem);
140
141        searchMenuItem = new JMenuItem("Search");
142        searchMenuItem.addActionListener(e -> showSearch());
143        commandsMenu.add(searchMenuItem);
144
145        quitMenuItem = new JMenuItem("Quit");
146        quitMenuItem.addActionListener(e -> showGuiQuitMenu());
147        commandsMenu.add(quitMenuItem);
148
149        menuBar.add(commandsMenu);
150        setJMenuBar(menuBar);
151
152        // ==============================
153        // CardLayout & Views
154        // ==============================
155
156        cardLayout = new CardLayout();
157        cardsPanel = new JPanel(cardLayout);
158
159        // Card 1: Welcome panel
160        JPanel welcomePanel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
161        welcomePanel.setBackground(BACKGROUND);
162        welcomePanel.setBorder(PADDING);
163
164        welcomeText = new JLabel();
165        welcomeText.setHorizontalAlignment(JLabel.CENTER);
166        refreshWelcomeText();
167        welcomePanel.add(welcomeText, BorderLayout.CENTER);
168
169        // Card 2: Add window (panel)
170        addWindow = new GUIAddWindow(activities);
171
172        // Card 3: Search window (panel)
173        searchWindow = new GUISearchWindow(activities);
174
175        cardsPanel.add(welcomePanel, "welcome");
176        cardsPanel.add(addWindow, "add");
177        cardsPanel.add(searchWindow, "search");
178
179        getContentPane().add(cardsPanel);
180
181        // Display the initial welcome view
182        cardLayout.show(cardsPanel, "welcome");
183
184        setVisible(true);
185    }
186
187    /**
188     * Switches the active card to the welcome panel and refreshes welcome text.
189     */
190    public void showWelcome() {
191        refreshWelcomeText();
192        cardLayout.show(cardsPanel, "welcome");
193    }
194
195    /**
196     * Switches the active card to the add activity view.
197     */
198    public void showAdd() {
199        cardLayout.show(cardsPanel, "add");
200    }
201
202    /**
203     * Switches the active card to the search activities view.
204     */
205    public void showSearch() {
206        cardLayout.show(cardsPanel, "search");
207    }
208
209    /**
210     * Switches the active card to the specified card name ("welcome", "add", "search").
211     * 
212     * @param name Name of the card to display.
213     */
214    public void showCard(String name) {
215        if ("welcome".equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
216            showWelcome();
217        } else {
218            cardLayout.show(cardsPanel, name);
219        }
220    }
221
222    /**
223     * Saves the list and exits the GUI. Shows an error message if there was an
224     * error saving the list.
225     */
226    public void quit() {
227        boolean errorOccurred = DayPlanner.quit(false);
228
229        String msg = errorOccurred
230            ? "<html>There was an error saving the list.<br>Click \"OK\" to exit DayPlanner.</html>"
231            : "<html>The list was saved successfully.<br>Now quitting DayPlanner. Goodbye!</html>";
232        int mode = errorOccurred 
233            ? JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE
234            : JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE;
235
236        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, msg, null, mode);
237        
238        dispose();
239        System.exit(0);
240    }
241
242    /**
243     * Shows the GUI quit confirmation menu.
244     */
245    public void showGuiQuitMenu() {
246        new GUIQuitMenu(this);
247    }
248
249    /**
250     * Refresh the welcome text label to display the current greeting and activity count.
251     */
252    public void refreshWelcomeText() {
253        if (welcomeText != null && activities != null) {
254            String greeting = DayPlannerUtils.getGreeting(activities.size()).trim();
255            String text = ("<html><div style='text-align: center; font-size: 14pt;'>"
256                         + "<b>Welcome to DayPlanner!</b><br><br>"
257                         + greeting
258                         + "<br><br>"
259                         + "Choose a command from the Commands menu above."
260                         + "</div></html>").replaceAll("\n", "<br>");
261            welcomeText.setText(text);
262        }
263    }
264
265    /**
266     * Gets the CardLayout instance used for switching views.
267     * 
268     * @return CardLayout instance.
269     */
270    public CardLayout getCardLayout() {
271        return cardLayout;
272    }
273
274    /**
275     * Gets the JPanel container holding the cards.
276     * 
277     * @return JPanel cards panel.
278     */
279    public JPanel getCardsPanel() {
280        return cardsPanel;
281    }
282
283    /**
284     * Gets the GUIAddWindow view panel.
285     * 
286     * @return GUIAddWindow instance.
287     */
288    public GUIAddWindow getAddWindow() {
289        return addWindow;
290    }
291
292    /**
293     * Gets the GUISearchWindow view panel.
294     * 
295     * @return GUISearchWindow instance.
296     */
297    public GUISearchWindow getSearchWindow() {
298        return searchWindow;
299    }
300
301    /**
302     * Gets the ActivityList instance.
303     * 
304     * @return ActivityList instance.
305     */
306    public ActivityList getActivities() {
307        return activities;
308    }
309
310    /**
311     * Gets the JMenuBar instance.
312     * 
313     * @return JMenuBar instance.
314     */
315    public JMenuBar getCommandsMenuBar() {
316        return menuBar;
317    }
318
319    /**
320     * Gets the Commands JMenu instance.
321     * 
322     * @return JMenu instance.
323     */
324    public JMenu getCommandsMenu() {
325        return commandsMenu;
326    }
327}
